typing.title: Typing capture
typing.scope: Capture actual edits in this pad, or import a journal from the optional Godot script adapter. Other applications and desktop text fields are not captured here.
typing.name: Take name
typing.seedHint: Enter the starting text first, then start capture.
typing.limit: Capture stopped at its size/event limit. The completed evidence is preserved; start a new take to continue.
typing.importError: Could not import this typing journal. It must be a complete, valid capture under 8 MiB.
typing.saveError: Could not save this take. A project can hold up to 20 typing takes.
typing.padSource: Source: this capture pad. Keys and selections are local to this field; the text changes are preserved separately.
typing.godotSource: Source: Godot unsaved script buffer · {{name}}. Edit causes are observed buffer changes; shortcut records are separate.
typing.previewHint: Each section replays from its own recorded starting text. Playback only changes this preview; it does not type into another app. Gaps over 1.5 seconds and pause/focus boundaries start a new section.
typing.limitedSource: This take ended at a capture limit. Replay covers the preserved edits only.
typing.startError: Starting text is too large. Use a smaller snippet.
typing.anchorHint: Optionally match each section’s first edit to a flag dropped during that recording. This is a human timing cue, not frame-accurate sync. Each section needs its own anchor after a pause. Presentation stops at the next pause or clip boundary.
typing.retainedAnchor: Saved recording anchor (flag or footage unavailable)

export.hint: Export sections with their starting buffers. Section, playback and bundle JSON files can be imported here without the video. Resulting code/text is the full buffer at that section’s end. Playback previews use the section speed and never type into another app.
export.error: Could not export this section. Choose a smaller section if it exceeds the file limit.

bundle.importHint: Each member has its own starting buffer. Review, preview and save members separately. Changes are kept while switching within this imported bundle.
bundle.hint: Choose 1–20 sections from this take. Style applies to preview, playback recipes and bundles; section JSON keeps the captured edits. Each bundle member keeps its own starting buffer.

integrations.title: Application integrations
integrations.scope: Optional integrations default to disabled. Capture-pad work, ordinary recording and saved takes remain available independently.
integrations.available-offline: Available for selected-file import. No live editor connection.
integrations.unavailable: The optional integration is unavailable in this runtime.
integrations.error: Settings could not be saved. Disabling stops current imports; a restart uses the last saved choice.
integrations.capability: Capability: Godot typing journal schema 1, tested with Godot 4.7.1. Reads the file you choose; plugin installation, monitoring and live capture require separate setup and permission.
integrations.failed: The optional import failed. Choose a supported complete journal, or disable the integration.
integrations.unsupportedEvidence: The stored integration provenance is unsupported. Validated typing content remains available; adapter-specific scope and clock claims are unverified.
integrations.incompatible: The optional provider contract is incompatible. Ordinary capture and saved evidence remain available.
integrations.enableHint: Enable Godot typing journal import in Application integrations, then try this file again.
integrations.unverifiedProvenance: Integration provenance is a source claim. It does not verify an application, collection scope or clock synchronization.

clockBridge.title: Godot recording clock link
clockBridge.scope: Separate permission for read-only clock metadata from one native Linux take. Choose a project and private link file, then connect that file in Godot. No text, keys or editor state is shared. The link expires after one hour or the paired take ends; pause status includes transport delay.
clockBridge.unavailable: A native Linux clock source is unavailable. Ordinary capture remains available.
clockBridge.paired: Project paired; waiting for a clock client.
clockBridge.waiting: Paired client is waiting for native recording clock samples.
clockBridge.stale: Clock samples are stale. Current recording state is unverified.
clockBridge.expired: Clock link expired. Create a new private link.
clockBridge.link: Open this private link file in the Godot addon:
clockBridge.error: Could not create or change the clock link. Choose project.godot and a new private link filename.
clockBridge.inspect: Inspect a saved clock sample journal
clockBridge.inspection: {{samples}} samples, {{gaps}} gaps, {{paused}} paused samples; maximum round trip {{rtt}} ms. Sampled source claims are unverified, not frame-accurate synchronization.
clockBridge.closed: The file was closed; continuous capture coverage is not certified.
clockBridge.unclosed: The file has no closing record; its ending is unverified.
clockBridge.inspectError: Could not validate this bounded clock sample journal.
clockBridge.helperError: The installed native helper does not support recording clock snapshots. Update the helper or continue with ordinary capture.
clockBridge.ended: The paired native take ended. Create a new private link for another recording.

code.title: Code presentation
code.added: Code added. Select its Code timeline region to style it.
code.addError: Place the playhead inside a video clip and choose a smaller code excerpt/section if needed.
code.geometryHint: Drag and resize the panel on the preview. Drag the timeline region edges to change its duration and typing pace. Long excerpts scroll to the caret.
code.clockHint: Pause picture freezes the screen and camera frames for this region. The timeline and original audio keep running; it resumes at the current timeline moment.
code.empty: Add a saved typing section using Typing capture
code.excerptError: Choose fewer lines or a shorter excerpt (up to 12,000 characters and 1,000 captured edits).

typingReview.title: Typing sections
typingReview.onsetHint: Markers show explicitly paired recording cues, not the duration or exact timing of every edit. Review each section independently; its original text and edit evidence remain saved.
typingReview.empty: No saved sections match. Save a typing take to review it here.

status.unavailable: Recording cue unavailable in current clips

lesson.title: Lesson guide
lesson.scope: Build editable, application-neutral steps and export an offline HTML/Markdown guide. No application integration is required.
lesson.unsaved: This lesson is separate from the video project. Save an editable copy before leaving this project; saving never replaces an existing file.
lesson.draft: Draft steps from flags and typing labels
lesson.privacy: Review selected instructions, code and image pixels before sharing, and describe every illustration before export. Export includes only selected steps and referenced images; no automatic redaction. Saving an editable copy retains every step and image. Exports and editable copies also retain selected evidence IDs, source project/render fingerprints and parent lesson lineage for traceability.
lesson.evidence: Source label: {{kind}}; original clock: {{clock}}. No action or timing alignment inferred.
lesson.frameSource: Composed frame at {{time}}s on the original editor ruler; source revision recorded.
lesson.error: The lesson operation could not finish. Save the video project before capturing a still, choose a visible frame and a new destination, then retry. Existing files are preserved.
lesson.code: Optional code (plain text, included in selected exports)

errors.lesson-operation-failed: The lesson operation could not finish. Check the selected lesson or destination and retry. Existing files are preserved.
errors.project-changed: Save and reload the current video project, then retry the lesson operation. Its render inputs changed or edits are unsaved.
errors.frame-unavailable: This ruler position has no kept source frame. Choose a visible position outside cuts and gaps.
errors.render-busy: A lesson operation is already running. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
errors.destination-exists: That file already exists. Choose a new filename; existing lessons are never replaced.
errors.local-draft-limit: The local recovery limit is reached. Delete unwanted local copies or save a new editable file elsewhere. Existing copies are preserved.
errors.local-draft-unavailable: The local recovery operation could not finish. Existing source lessons remain unchanged. Check the visible storage location and retry.
errors.range-unavailable: Choose a positive range whose start and end are in kept, probed video. Removed boundaries, overlapping spans or too many cuts cannot be planned.
errors.range-target-changed: The lesson step or its saved range changed. Review the current step and try again. To use another video project, remove the old range first.
errors.range-source-unavailable: A source video is missing or has not been approved for this editor. Open or import it through the video project, save, then retry.
errors.range-source-unsupported: Source confirmation supports Linux video-only ranges from 1/30 second to 120 seconds, up to 32 kept spans and 8 source files (8 GiB total). Use a simple range without webcam, added audio, image backgrounds or image annotations; check that its source files are readable.
errors.range-source-changed: The source video or saved project changed during confirmation. Review the current video, save the project, then explicitly refresh the range and current source.
errors.range-source-cancelled: Source confirmation was cancelled. The lesson range was not changed.
errors.range-export-unattested: Confirm the current source for this included step before exporting its MP4. Older range references are kept until you explicitly refresh them.
errors.range-export-unsupported: This MP4 export supports Linux video-only ranges from 1/30 second to 120 seconds, up to 32 kept spans and 8 source files (8 GiB total). Remove unsupported webcam, added audio or image dependencies, save the project and explicitly refresh after reviewing the current source.
errors.range-export-changed: The saved project or source video differs from the confirmed range. Review the current video, save the project, then explicitly refresh the range and source before exporting.
errors.range-export-incomplete: The MP4 could not be verified. Any new unfinished files are kept for inspection; they are not a completed export. Check the source video and destination, then retry.
errors.range-export-cancelled: MP4 export stopped. No completed export was certified after cancellation.
errors.range-export-source-unavailable: A source video is missing or not approved for this editor. Open or import it through the video project, save, review and explicitly refresh the range before retrying.
errors.range-export-tool-unavailable: The video verification tool is unavailable. Reinstall or update OpenScreen, or ask your administrator to check the configured FFmpeg tool, then retry. Unverified files are kept; this is not a completed export.

output.title: Guide output settings
output.scope: Presets change presentation only. Inclusion switches remove excluded material from the guide and its editable export; your saved source lesson keeps all content. These settings never enable an integration or collect data.

query.title: Find and review steps
query.summary: {{matches}} matches of {{total}} steps; {{reviewed}} source steps marked reviewed; {{checks}} checks need attention.
query.problems: Only steps with checks to review
query.hidden: {{count}} selected steps are hidden by these filters. Select matches or clear filters before exporting.
query.scope: Checks describe this source lesson; they are not tutor approval, privacy clearance or proof of achievement. Filtering does not change source steps or original evidence.
query.reorder: Clear filters to reorder all source steps.
query.demoted: The edited source step is now draft and stays visible until filters change.
query.promoted: The source step is marked reviewed and stays visible until filters change.
query.pinned: Edited rows that no longer match stay visible until you change or clear the filters.

findings.empty-instructions: Instructions are empty; review whether the title alone is sufficient.
findings.missing-alt: Illustration needs an alternative description if included.

drafts.title: Local recovery copies
drafts.scope: Save a complete local snapshot only when you click Save recovery copy. This includes all source steps, code and illustrations, regardless of guide inclusion settings. This feature writes only to the app-data location shown below. This is manual recovery, not autosave or a backup guarantee.
drafts.inventory: {{copies}} storage entries of {{max}}; {{bytes}} MiB counted toward the {{limit}} MiB limit. Interrupted temporary entries also count.
drafts.confirmRestore: This copy has {{steps}} steps at revision {{revision}}. Restoring replaces the current unsaved dialog draft. Save your current draft first if needed; existing source and recovery files remain unchanged.
drafts.restored: Recovery copy restored into the dialog. Save future edits explicitly.
drafts.confirmDelete: Delete this local recovery copy permanently? Other source lessons, exports and recovery copies remain unchanged.
drafts.limit: The local recovery limit is reached. Delete unwanted local copies or save a new editable file elsewhere. Existing copies are preserved.
drafts.error: The local recovery operation could not finish. Existing source lessons remain unchanged. Check the visible storage location and retry.
drafts.inventoryLimited: Storage listing limit reached. At least {{copies}} recognized entries use {{bytes}} MiB; manage the visible recovery folder before saving more.

range.title: Video range reference
range.scope: Explicit range selection on the saved editor timeline. Attach a reference only, or explicitly confirm the current source contents. Cuts and speed affect the resulting video duration. Export an included step’s confirmed range as an MP4 with a separate destination choice.
range.stored: Stored reference: {{start}}–{{end}} ruler seconds, {{spans}} kept spans. Source media availability and frame accuracy are unverified.
range.confirmScope: Confirming reads the selected source video files and records their current contents with this step. Linux only: video-only ranges from 1/30 second to 120 seconds, up to 32 kept spans, 8 files and 8 GiB total; no webcam, added audio or image assets. Source audio is not verified. This does not export or play video. Include this step and save the video project first.
range.confirm: Confirm current source and attach range
range.confirmed: Source contents recorded at your last confirmation. Current availability and later changes have not been checked. Refresh only after reviewing the current video; previous selections are retained.
range.unconfirmed: Source contents have not been confirmed for this range.
range.confirmedNotice: Current source confirmed and attached. Save an editable lesson copy or a local recovery copy to keep it.
range.cancelled: Source confirmation cancelled; the lesson range was not changed.
range.working: Reading selected source videos… This may take a while for large files.
range.cancelling: Cancelling source confirmation… Waiting for the current file read to finish.
range.exportScope: Export only this included step’s confirmed range. Linux only; the supported video-only subset above applies. Video timing and decoded frames are checked; source audio and audio alignment are not verified. No full-project fallback or automatic source refresh.
range.exported: MP4 video checked and saved in: {{path}}
range.exportCancelled: MP4 export cancelled; existing lesson and source files are unchanged.
range.exportCancelling: Cancelling MP4 export… Waiting for current work to finish; some native work cannot stop immediately.

exportPhases.choosing-destination: Choose a destination folder to continue. Cancelling the picker creates no export.
exportPhases.validating: Checking the exported video and source again…
